name: @local/vibe64-atomic-file
description: Vibe64's one atomic file writer: the whole new content in a temporary file beside the file, renamed (or linked) into place. Plain Node with no dependency, so every package uses it, the privileged helper, Genesis and the deploy engine among them.

surfaces.summary: writeFileAtomic and writeFileAtomicSync: a file replaced or created whole, under one temporary-file name, durable unless asked otherwise.
